ops.title: TestShipGateProbe/authenticated_outside_a_repo hangs indefinitely on main
ops.description:
`internal/cli` never completes: `TestShipGateProbe` hangs on its fourth subtest and only exits via the Go test-timeout panic. This makes `task test` red on `main` regardless of what else is in the working copy.

## Confirmed pre-existing

Reproduced at clean HEAD `baffb08` ("fix(vcs)!: make the graphite reachability gate actually gate") in a detached worktree with no local changes:

```
=== RUN   TestShipGateProbe
=== RUN   TestShipGateProbe/reachable
=== RUN   TestShipGateProbe/not_synced
=== RUN   TestShipGateProbe/server_unreachable
=== RUN   TestShipGateProbe/authenticated_outside_a_repo
panic: test timed out after 2m30s
FAIL github.com/yasyf/cc-context/internal/cli 150.275s
```

The first three subtests pass; `authenticated_outside_a_repo` (`internal/cli/lane_test.go:293`, `stdout: "Authenticated as: yasyf"`) never returns. Stack at the timeout:

```
internal/cli.runShipCmdFull  internal/cli/ship_test.go:443
internal/cli.TestShipGateProbe.func1  internal/cli/lane_test.go:310
  -> cobra (*Command).Execute -> ExecuteC -> command.go:1015
```

Under `-race` via `task test` the same hang burns the full default 10m budget (`FAIL internal/cli 600.288s`).

Note a clean worktree also needs the gitignored WASM artifacts copied in (`internal/format/formatcore.wasm`, `internal/semsearch/embed/embedcore.wasm`, `internal/semsearch/chunk/grammars/*.wasm.gz`) or the package fails at setup before reaching the test.

## Why it needs an owner decision

`gtReachable` (`internal/cli/lane.go`) is documented as inherently a server round trip — "Only the server can answer: a live `.graphite_repo_config` carries no repo identity". The subtest name says *outside a repo*, so the interesting question is what `runShipCmdFull` reaches for when no repo root resolves, and whether the 5s `gtProbeTimeout` is on that path at all. That is a design call for whoever owns the gt lane, not a mechanical fix — HEAD is itself an in-flight rework of this gate.

## Workaround

`go test -race -skip 'TestShipGateProbe' ./...` gives a clean signal on everything else.

ops.text: `go test -count=1 -timeout 150s -run TestShipGateProbe ./internal/cli/` passes, all four subtests reported
`task test` completes without the internal/cli timeout panic
The authenticated_outside_a_repo path is bounded by a timeout or stubbed so it makes no unbounded external call
